title: feat(metadata-protocol,cli,cloud-connection)!: `__c` extension fields only in a base's paired .custom package, judged at every door (ADR-0146 D10)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XB8y3FqD5csjtFmNMzvKsg5)_

Fixes #28564

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
New refusals at the save, restore and publish doors, `duplicatePackage`, `os validate` and the marketplace install narrow the accepted set: a field spelled `__c` outside a base's paired `.custom` package, and a `.custom` extension field without the suffix. No `packages/spec/**` file is touched; no schema, type, error code or runtime interface moves.

Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — no file under `skills/**` teaches a field spelled `__c`, an `objectExtensions` field name or a `BASE.custom` package; the measured count below found none.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:ADR-0146 D10 的第一条规则落地——`__c` 后缀只给基础包配对的 `.custom` 包用。一个判官(`judgeExtensionFieldSuffix`),保存/恢复/发布三道门、复制包、`os validate`、市场安装都问它。非 `.custom` 包里出现 `xxx__c` 字段被拒(让改名);`.custom` 包的对象扩展字段不带 `__c` 被拒(让加后缀,或用 `fieldPatches` 改基础字段的显示属性)。
- 为什么改:客户字段叫 `region__c`,厂商下个版本永远不会占用这个名字,也没人会把客户字段当成厂商字段——前提是每道门都拒。之前后缀只在 spec 里声明,没有一道门读它。
- 风险与回滚:收窄只拦一个今天没人用的拼法:在 `2678600d` 上实测 `examples/**`、`packages/*/src`、`skills/**`(不含测试)里 `[a-z0-9]__c` 字段名 0 个(7 处文本命中全在文档注释里)。每道门沿用自己的信封,不新增错误码。回滚即 revert,无数据迁移。
- 先看:`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-extension-field-suffix.ts`(判官与两句话);`protocol.ts` 的保存门、`promoteDraftForPublish`、`duplicatePackage` 三处接线;`cloud-connection` 安装门的步骤 1c''。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run src/protocol.extension-field-suffix.test.ts`,预期 `Tests 20 passed (20)`。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地(合同审查后)。

## What changes

- **One judge** (`@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, new `protocol-extension-field-suffix.ts`, exported from the index). `judgeExtensionFieldSuffix({ packageId, objects, objectExtensions, at })` is pure and answers every refused field, located. It reads the spec's predicates, `isExtensionFieldName` (`@objectstack/spec/data`) and `isCustomizationPackage` (`@objectstack/spec/kernel`), and spells neither the suffix nor the pair rule.
  - (a) `reserved_outside_pair`: in a package that is not a `.custom` pair, a field spelled `__c` on its own objects or in its `objectExtensions`: "Field 'F' on object 'O' in package 'P': the `__c` suffix is reserved to a base's paired `.custom` package (ADR-0146 D10); rename the field."
  - (b) `unsuffixed_in_pair`: in a `.custom` pair, an `objectExtensions[].fields` key without the suffix: "Extension field 'F' on object 'O' in package 'P': name it `F__c`, or change a base field's display properties in the extension's patch (`fieldPatches`)." The patch slot is named as it stands on `main` (#28560's `ObjectExtensionSchema.fieldPatches`).
  - Not judged: a `.custom` pair's own new objects, an extension of one of them, and a write bound to no package (the package-unbound row is the environment's own, as `objectNamespacePrefixViolation` already skips it).
  - Beside it: `extensionFieldSuffixRefusalError` (the active doors' `VALIDATION_ERROR` / 400 envelope, `issues[]` locating each field) and `objectBodyExtensionFieldSuffixRefusal(type, item, name, binding)` (the one-item question the save, restore and promotion doors ask, on the RESOLVED binding, as `permissionSetOwnerBindingRefusal` reads it).
- **The three `active` doors**, each beside the `permissionSetOwnerBindingRefusal` call: the save door (every writer, both modes, binding from `saveWriteBinding`), the restore (`restoredBodyWriter`, so `rollbackMetaItem` and `revertCommit`'s restore limb), and the draft promotion `publishMetaItem` and `publishPackageDrafts` share (`promoteDraftForPublish`, against `promoteInto`, before `repo.promoteDraft` writes; a batch publish reports it in `failed` and aborts).
- **`duplicatePackage`**, judged against the target id after the rows are read and before the copy's first mutation (the package record): a copy of a `.custom` pair's `__c` objects into a plain id is refused whole, `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`, nothing minted or copied.
- **`os validate`** (`@objectstack/cli`, new `utils/extension-field-suffix.ts`, step 3a-iv beside N-09's 3a-iii): each `packages[]` entry under its own id, or the stack under `manifest.id`; exit 1, the rows on `errors` with `path`, `code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR'`, `rule`, `packageId`, `message`, and printed with the path without `--json`. The build/validate parity ledger records the call under `VALIDATE_ONLY_GATES` with its reason (ADR-0146 decided item 7 names publish, validate and install, not `os build`).
- **Marketplace install** (`@objectstack/cloud-connection`, step 1c'' right after the dependency check): every delivered package (each `packages[]` entry under its own id, the body otherwise) is judged before the manifest service sees the artifact and before the install-mode branch, so the managed and the unmanaged install are both covered. The answer is this door's existing body refusal, `422 VALIDATION_ERROR` (the unrunnable-code refusal's code and status), with `details.refusals`; nothing is registered and no ledger entry is written.
- `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json`: the new test file's three engine doubles, written by `check-engine-double-contract.mjs --write`.

## Acceptance notes

- **`installPackage` gets no call: its closed manifest covers it** (seat 1 accepted this reading before the first edit). `PackageInstallManifestSchema` is a `strictObject` whose `objects` are glob strings and which has no `objectExtensions` key, so an `x__c` field body never reaches the door: it is refused `400` by that parse before any write. A judge call there would judge an empty set. N-09 (#28410, PR #28554) met the same fact and moved its install gate to the marketplace install. Pinned in `protocol.extension-field-suffix.test.ts` section 5.
- **Case (b) is pinned where an extension can arrive** (seat 1 accepted). Only `os validate` and the marketplace install receive `objectExtensions`; the save, restore and promotion doors and `duplicatePackage` only see `object` bodies, where a `.custom` pair's own object is not judged. Those doors pin case (a) and the pair's admit; the judge's own section pins (b), and the validate and install files pin it at those doors. #28574 (the runtime `object_extension` write door) asks this judge from its own card.
- **handleInstall's position.** The call sits at the dependency check's early position (step 1c''), as the card asks, so it also covers the unmanaged branch, which leaves before N-09's step 2d. It judges the body as delivered (before the ADR-0087 forward conversion), which does not touch field names. #28565's patch-target judge adds its own separate line; the two are not folded.
- A draft save that names no package is judged at its promotion, not at the save: `saveWriteBinding` resolves the store-read binding for permission sets only, and an object draft is not live until a door promotes it.
- `protocol-packaged-base-refusal.ts` is not edited (#28412 holds it).

## Tests

- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.extension-field-suffix.test.ts` (20): the judge's two cases, its admits and what it does not judge (6); the save door in publish and draft mode, every field located, and the control (pair admit, plain field, no package) (4); `rollbackMetaItem`, `revertCommit`'s restore limb and the control (3); `publishMetaItem`, `publishPackageDrafts` and the pair's batch control (3); `duplicatePackage` from `app.dupsrc.custom` into a plain id refused whole, and its control (2); `installPackage` refusing an object body and an `objectExtensions` entry at its parse (2).
- `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-extension-field-suffix.test.ts` (6): (a) on an extension and on an own object, (b), a `packages[]` artifact judged per entry, the refusal ahead of the install-mode judgement (`installMode: 'unmanaged'`), and the control (the pair's `region__c` and a vendor extension's plain field install). Each refusal asserts nothing registered and no ledger entry.
- `packages/cli/src/utils/extension-field-suffix.test.ts` (4, unit) and `packages/cli/test/validate-extension-field-suffix.test.ts` (3, the command, integration tier): (a) exits 1 with the path on `errors`, (b) exits 1 with the path printed, the pair's `region__c` validates clean.
- **Red first on base**: the four door files restored to `2678600d57` (judge module and tests kept): metadata-protocol 8 failed / 12 passed (every door pin red; the judge, the controls and the `installPackage` coverage pins green), cloud-connection 5 failed / 1 passed (the control green), cli command 2 failed / 5 passed. Restore proved by `git diff HEAD` empty.
- **Ablations, one per door**, each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit once, blob changed, restore blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty after): save door (call handed another type) 3 failed; promotion 2 failed; restore 2 failed; `duplicatePackage` (throw condition inverted) 1 failed; `os validate` (judged `{}`) 2 failed; marketplace install (package id dropped) 5 failed. No `dist/` is on any of these resolution paths (metadata-protocol and cloud-connection tests import their own `src`, the cli command runs its `src` through tsx).
- Existing install and validate fixtures stay green: the full suites below.

## Verification

Run on `40dfde1a` (`737815d4` + the engine-double ledger commit `6923eb9f` + one merge of `origin/main` at `da6f0ce3`), each test command under `os-verify-lock` (`VERDICT command-exit 0`).

- Merge: one conflict, `packages/cli/test/validate-build-gate-parity.test.ts`. #28681 (card #28643) moved `findOverrideDeclarationRefusals` out of `VALIDATE_ONLY_GATES` by wiring `os build`; this branch keeps that and records `findExtensionFieldSuffixRefusals` there (the card names no build door), with the docblock updated. `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` exit 0; `turbo run build` (docs and `ui/` excluded) exit 0.
- `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` full suite: Test Files 292 passed, 4 skipped (296); Tests 21970 passed, 26 skipped.
- `@objectstack/cloud-connection` full suite: Test Files 66 passed (66); Tests 802 passed (802).
- `@objectstack/cli` unit tier: Test Files 365 passed (365); Tests 5171 passed (5171). Integration tier, the two validate gate files (`validate-extension-field-suffix`, `validate-override-declarations`): 2 files, 5 tests passed. The rest of the integration tier is CI's.
- Typecheck metadata-protocol, cli, cloud-connection: exit 0. `eslint --no-inline-config packages/metadata-protocol packages/cli packages/cloud-connection`: exit 0.
- Dogfood battery (`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test`, the narrowing arm): Test Files 369 passed, 3 skipped (372); Tests 2981 passed, 28 skipped.
- Derived gates (`dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, reconciled with `--ran`): `✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 74 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 74 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`. `check:engine-double-contract` first read 1 (the new file's three doubles unrecorded) and is green after `--write`; `check:type-check-debt` first read 3 (lock wait behind this branch's own dogfood run) and is green on its re-run.
- Count (migration note): `git grep -nE "[a-z0-9]__c\b"` over `examples/**`, `packages/*/src/**`, `skills/**`, tests excluded, at `2678600d57`: 7 hits, all in doc comments (`field-customization.ts`, `object.zod.ts`, `validation.zod.ts`); 0 field names.

<details><summary>Live probe: the stock showcase, through the save door</summary>

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-showcase dev -- --fresh -p 4310` (the `ui/` dists were not built, so `pnpm dev`'s prerequisite check was skipped; REST only), signed in as the seeded dev admin with `Origin: http://localhost:4310`.

1. `POST /api/v1/packages` with `{"manifest":{"id":"app.probevendor","name":"Probe vendor","version":"1.0.0","type":"app"},"enableOnInstall":true}`: 201.
2. `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/probevendor_ticket?package=app.probevendor` with fields `title` and `x__c`: **400**, `code: VALIDATION_ERROR`, `issues: [{ path: 'fields.x__c', code: 'custom' }]`, message: "Field 'x__c' on object 'probevendor_ticket' in package 'app.probevendor': the `__c` suffix is reserved to a base's paired `.custom` package (ADR-0146 D10); rename the field."
3. The same object without `x__c`: 200, saved active in `app.probevendor`.
4. `POST /api/v1/packages/com.example.showcase/ensure-customization`: 201, pair `com.example.showcase.custom`, namespace `showcase_custom`. (The ensure door answers 409 for the writable `app.probevendor`: a pair is for a read-only base.)
5. `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/showcase_custom_ticket?package=com.example.showcase.custom` with fields `title` and `x__c`: **200**, saved active in the pair. The save door takes no `objectExtensions` entry (#28574's door), so the pair's own object stands in for "the pair's extension"; the extension admit is pinned at `os validate` and the install door.

</details>
